terminalRule: All eligible gates PASS; evidence-dependent gates PASS or CLOSED_BY_DESIGN; founder/external gates have explicit OWNER_GATE packets; no UNKNOWN remains on a launch-critical gate.

gates.name: Production host and deployment health
currentEvidence: Canonical host returned HTTP 200
Observed Vercel production deployment state READY
Connected Vercel runtime-error query returned no errors for the preceding 24-hour window
requiredEvidence: Repeat during release-candidate and post-deploy verification
gates.rollback: Promote the last verified production deployment

gates.name: Production commit equals approved release candidate
currentEvidence: Production served commit 0e56c4770e715630eaaac974702336447e367b5a
Active recovery work in PR #129 is not included in that deployment
requiredEvidence: Production deployment reports the same commit
gates.rollback: Promote the last verified production deployment

gates.name: Proof API health and reproducibility
currentEvidence: /llms.txt, ledger, receipts, verification spec, and OpenAPI returned HTTP 200
A sampled receipt leaf hash was independently recomputed and matched
requiredEvidence: Automated known-answer and receipt-hash checks in Sentinel v2
Post-release verification against the approved production commit
gates.rollback: Revert to the last verified proof-surface release

gates.name: Public proof-ledger publication
currentEvidence: /api/proof/ledger is healthy but returns published:false because PUBLISH_LEDGER is unset
requiredEvidence: Proof semantics and copy independently reviewed
No bootstrap, seed, or ineligible rows
gates.rollback: Unset PUBLISH_LEDGER and retain the honest gated response

gates.name: Unattended Nightly Sentinel coverage
currentEvidence: Scheduled Claude sentinel executed zero checks because WebFetch required interactive provenance approval
requiredEvidence: Retries, timeouts, JSON and Markdown receipts
Scheduled execution with two consecutive green runs
gates.rollback: Disable only the broken schedule while preserving manual probe commands

gates.name: Pricing, checkout, FAQ, and Terms refund consistency
currentEvidence: Pricing promises a 3-day money-back guarantee
Production Terms describe refunds as discretionary
DEC-050 records a branch fix that is not deployed
gates.rollback: Withhold the stronger promise until every surface and operational process agrees

gates.name: Production analytics configuration
currentEvidence: Production HTML initializes Microsoft Clarity with the literal identifier undefined
Cloudflare analytics beacon is present
requiredEvidence: Valid identifier or intentional script omission
gates.rollback: Omit the optional analytics integration when configuration is absent

gates.name: Paid-plan promise-to-runtime parity
currentEvidence: Pricing publicly promises premium tools and real-time email/push alerts
No end-to-end production entitlement and delivery evidence was established in this baseline
requiredEvidence: End-to-end test for every promised capability
gates.rollback: Withhold or revise any promise lacking production proof

gates.name: Stripe test-mode checkout lifecycle
currentEvidence: Repository contains substantial billing, webhook, paywall, and entitlement hardening
A current end-to-end checkout-to-entitlement receipt was not established in this baseline
requiredEvidence: Subscription upgrade, downgrade, cancel, refund, and restore
No secret material in logs or receipts
gates.rollback: Disable checkout entry while preserving account and public free surfaces

gates.name: Stripe live transaction and payout readiness
currentEvidence: Live credential, price, webhook, tax, payout, and dashboard configuration were not inspected or mutated
requiredEvidence: Owner confirms live account and payout readiness
Live price IDs match public plan copy
Production webhook endpoint and secret configured
gates.rollback: Disable live checkout and preserve the test-mode path

gates.name: Authentication and account lifecycle in production
currentEvidence: Public sign-in and account entry points are rendered
A complete production sign-in, session, account, entitlement, and sign-out receipt was not established
gates.rollback: Disable account-dependent conversion paths while preserving public read-only surfaces

gates.name: Production schema and migration convergence
currentEvidence: Several additive migration lanes remain founder-gated
No production migration was authorized or executed during this baseline
gates.rollback: Use additive compatibility and restore from verified backup when necessary

gates.name: Schedulers, ingestion, settlement, and data freshness
currentEvidence: Public site displays current data and settled-record counts
A complete scheduler inventory and fresh production-run receipt was not established
requiredEvidence: Every cron/worker has owner, cadence, last success, freshness SLO, and alert
gates.rollback: Fail closed or show an honest stale/unavailable state

gates.name: Public performance and win-rate claims
currentEvidence: Trust and proof guardrails exist
Publication eligibility depends on population, sample, calibration, and founder policy
gates.rollback: Withhold the metric and preserve methodology/proof explanations

gates.name: Email and push alert delivery
currentEvidence: Real-time email and push alerts are presented as an Elite benefit
Current draft-only doctrine prohibits uncontrolled outbound publishing/sending
gates.rollback: Withhold the paid promise and keep alert generation draft-only

gates.name: News sitemap publication intent
currentEvidence: /news-sitemap.xml returns valid XML with an empty URL set
requiredEvidence: Confirm whether zero eligible news URLs is intentional
If not intentional, repair content eligibility or sitemap generation
gates.rollback: Serve a valid empty sitemap rather than fabricated or ineligible URLs

gates.name: Branch, PR, and capability accounting
currentEvidence: User-provided campaign receipt reports 114 of 138 long-tail branches evidenced through DEC-052
Twenty-four sensitive branches remain in task #74
Some branch-local state and PR summaries lag the latest decision ledger
requiredEvidence: Every open PR has a current disposition
Every unique useful unit has one canonical owner
Current state, queue, decision register, recovery matrix, and PR body agree
Deletion receipts for any branch removal
gates.rollback: Preserve branches and classify UNKNOWN rather than delete or supersede without proof

gates.name: Release-candidate verification
currentEvidence: No single approved release-candidate commit currently represents the reconciled product
PR #129 is an accounting/recovery container and must not be merged wholesale
requiredEvidence: Build, secret scan, Prisma validation when applicable
Independent review and protected-zone red team
gates.rollback: Discard the candidate branch without affecting production

gates.name: Revenue funnel observability
currentEvidence: Pricing and checkout calls-to-action are public
A verified end-to-end funnel event sequence was not established
Clarity configuration is currently defective
requiredEvidence: Plan-view, CTA, checkout-start, checkout-complete, entitlement-active, cancellation, and refund events
Dashboard or query proving event arrival
gates.rollback: Remove optional broken analytics rather than report false coverage

gates.name: Post-launch observation and rollback readiness
currentEvidence: Cannot begin until a release candidate is approved and deployed
requiredEvidence: Runtime, checkout, webhook, entitlement, ingestion, settlement, proof, and data-freshness metrics
gates.rollback: Promote the last verified deployment and close affected gates
